name: run-high
description: 런하이 — 인증된 기록으로 내 페이스에 맞는 러너와 믿고 함께 달리는 러닝 커뮤니티

scripts.build: npm run build -w @runhigh/web && npm run build -w @runhigh/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @runhigh/core && npm run test -w @runhigh/server && npm run test -w @runhigh/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @runhigh/core && npm run typecheck -w @runhigh/server && npm run typecheck -w @runhigh/web
